lastCompletedStory.title: Add a negative control (`.env.example` must stay unignored) locking the non-blanket dotenv gitignore rule shape

nextStoryContext: test/templates-gitignore-dotenv.test.ts now has both a positive control (DOTENV_FILES, must be ignored) AND a negative control (NOT_IGNORED_FILES = ['.env.example'], must NOT be ignored) in both the verbatim-write and merge-path tests. Swept red-against-main: mutating templates/.gitignore to a blanket `.env*` + regenerating src/vendor/_generated.ts via `bun run embed-vendor` makes the new NOT_IGNORED_FILES assertions fail (confirming they actually lock the non-blanket rule shape), then reverted cleanly (git diff --stat empty on both files post-revert) before committing. No production code changed; templates/.gitignore and src/vendor/_generated.ts are untouched by this story.
